using microservice architecture. 
Roles played: Developer 
Team Size: 5 
Responsibilities: Actively contributed to configuring Netflix technologies to 
manage communication between newly created RESTful sub -modules and to 
expose them on the web. Additionally, set up CI/CD pipelines for the automated 
deployment of all modules to AWS cloud servers. 
Technology used: Spring boot, Eureka, Zuul, Ribbon, Feign, Hystrix, Turbine, 
Zipkin, jenkin, ELK, Docker 
 
2. Project summary: The Indian Eagle web application was initially an  online OTA

same business functionalities with JSON responses. 
Roles played: Task lead 
Team Size: 7 
Responsibilities: Actively contributed to configuring Ratpack to handle all

Technology used: Spring boot, ratpack, netty, groovy, Spring config server,
